args: docker ps --filter ancestor=crystaldba/postgres-mcp --format '{{.ID}} {{.RunningFor}}' | awk '/hour|day|week/ {print $1}' | xargs docker rm -f >/dev/null 2>&1; export $(grep ^DATABASE_URL .env | xargs) && URI=$(echo "$DATABASE_URL" | sed 's/localhost/host.docker.internal/;s/127.0.0.1/host.docker.internal/') && exec docker run -i --rm --init -e DATABASE_URI="$URI" crystaldba/postgres-mcp --access-mode=unrestricted
